headline: Sales climb but the quarter ends in a net loss
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 15.50T, up 34.0% y/y and 9.3% q/q, but operating profit fell 17.4% y/y to KRW 561.2B and the net result was a KRW 600.0B loss.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the preliminary results reports a pre-tax loss of KRW 645.5B. The petrochemicals segment posted an operating loss of KRW 175.6B, while the battery-unit operating profit was KRW 756B. Yahoo EPS was KRW -8,250 against KRW 1,445 last quarter. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage of preliminary results. Shard revenue growth (+38%) and operating income (KRW 3.05T) differ from the reported figures and are not used. EPS is Yahoo data.
